changes: 新增 process-fact-levels registry 覆盖 84 个 CLI 命令和 3 个 runtime behavior，并让 process fact contract test 从 registry 校验覆盖、等级、L4 gateConsumer 与 prompt drift。同步修复 reviewer item dispatch，避免 koala-review-* 拿到 implementer prompt。
usage: 运行 npm run test:process-fact-contract 可查看 Process Fact Level Registry 输出；新增 CLI command 或 runtime process fact 时必须在 packages/main/src/core/process-fact-levels.ts 登记等级、owner 和 rationale。
expectedOutcome: 用户运行 npm run test:process-fact-contract 后看到 Process Fact Level Registry、entries: 87、runtime soft-point 行，以及 Process fact contract verified。
actualTranscript: 实际输出包含 entries: 87 (84 CLI, 3 runtime)、levels: L0=31, L1=14, L2=19, L3=2, L4=21，并列出 runtime:phase_tools_malformed_allow_all、runtime:test_auto_recursive_skip、runtime:validate_fallback_discovery，最后显示 Process fact contract verified。
outcomeDiff: expected 与 actual 一致；额外显示 truth_nav/truth_extract/doctor 为 L2，覆盖 quality review 发现的 L0 误标风险。
limitations: none — fully covered by process-fact contract, reviewer item dispatch smoke, build, koala validate, and reviewer passes.
pitfalls: channel gate 会检查代码提交 author；implementer subagent 的提交需要 author=koala-implementer，metadata-only koala:* 提交才允许由主 agent 作者保留。
